containers.idleTimeout: Timed out waiting for container list segments or a success final state; partial results were not returned.
containers.disconnected: The authentication connection dropped before the container list completed.
containers.overflow: The container list response exceeded safety limits; truncated data is not treated as complete.
containers.invalidJson: The container list contained invalid JSON.
containers.schemaChanged: The container list structure changed; unknown formats are not treated as an empty list.
containers.closedEarly: The NAS closed the authentication connection before the container list completed.
containers.totalTimeout: The container list exceeded its total time budget; partial segments were not returned.
containers.alreadyFinished: The container list already finished; later responses were rejected.
containers.denied: The NAS denied or cancelled the container port inventory. Check Docker permissions.
containers.unknownState: The container list returned an unknown state; partial data was not treated as complete.
containers.overLimit: The container list exceeded this tool's safety limits; truncated data is not treated as complete.
containers.unsupportedMetadata: The container list contained unsupported identifiers or metadata; no guessed mappings were generated.
containers.missingSuccess: The container list never reached a success final state, so partial data cannot be returned.
containers.unavailable: The inventory failed or never reached a success final state; partial data is hidden and unknown is not reported as zero ports.
containers.summary: Collected {containers} containers and {publishedPorts} published port records after the success final state; only names, states and port metadata are kept.
containers.scope: Container port metadata from this account's containerList; includes TCP/UDP published records and exposed-only ports. Host network mode and non-Docker NAS listeners are not enumerated.
containers.noHostPort: No valid host port is published; ports exposed inside the container cannot be proxied directly.
containers.unsupportedProtocol: This published record is display-only; this tool does not forward UDP or unknown protocols.
containers.registryUnavailable: The Docker remote mapping source was not read, so domain assignment cannot be determined.
containers.ambiguous: The container prefix is ambiguous or matches multiple remote domains; none is chosen automatically.
containers.noDomain: No valid remote domain matches this container and host port; global port numbers are not used for guessing.
containers.mapped: Both the container ID prefix and host port match. Registration does not prove the service or HTTP API is reachable.

inventory.listMissing: The NAS entry response has no data.list, so list completeness cannot be confirmed.
inventory.entryNoPort: No valid dedicated port; this may be a built-in NAS entry or relative path, so no port proxy can be created.
inventory.entryNoDomain: A port exists but no fnDomain; no FN Connect service subdomain yet.
inventory.entryInvalidDomain: The remote subdomain violates the safety rules for this FN ID and was rejected.
inventory.entryMapped: The server provided a port and subdomain pair; reachability still needs a separate test.
inventory.sourceReadOk: Registered mappings visible to this account were read; this is not all listening ports.
inventory.sourceReadFailed: Read failed: possibly missing permission, unsupported version, changed response structure or a connection error. This source is not counted as an empty list.
inventory.sourcesUnavailable: Neither desktop entries nor Docker mappings could be read. Check the NAS login, permissions and version.
inventory.scopeSingle: Registered entries visible to this account; not all NAS listening ports, and reachability is not guaranteed.
inventory.scopeMerged: Merged NAS desktop and Docker quick access registrations visible to this account. Failed sources are marked separately; this is not all NAS listening ports.
inventory.registriesUnavailable: Remote registration sources were not read; container published ports cannot be used to infer remote domains.
inventory.scopeContainersOnly: Only container published port metadata is available; remote registration sources were not read, so ports are not claimed to have FN Connect domains.

sync.multipleDomains: NAS port {port} matches multiple remote domains. The existing domain is kept; manual confirmation required.
